   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Grinding example\n",
    "\n",
    "This notebook runs the fragmentation population balance model defined in\n",
    "`grinding.i` and plots the two things a grinding model is expected to show:\n",
    "the size distribution shifting from the coarse feed toward the fines, and\n",
    "conservation of total mass. The model, its math, and a walkthrough of the\n",
    "input file are described on the [](modules-pbm) page."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7fd8199a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Breakage model\n",
    "\n",
    "This example fixes the two constitutive choices (see [](modules-pbm) for the\n",
    "population balance equation and the flux operator derivation):\n",
    "\n",
    "- **Fragmentation rate** -- increasing with size, with a sink at the smallest bin,\n",
    "  $\\gamma_i = 0.05\\, i$ (so $\\gamma_0 = 0$).\n",
    "- **Daughter distribution** -- each parent splits its mass equally over all\n",
    "  smaller bins, $p_{kj} = v_j / (j\\, v_k)$ for $k < j$, which conserves mass at\n",
    "  uniform density."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "411bc89e",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-28T21:28:19.521310Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-28T21:28:19.520839Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-28T21:28:22.660787Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-28T21:28:22.658929Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "\n",
    "import neml2\n",
    "\n",
    "torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float64)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "84d8316a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Load the input file, fetch the `TransientDriver`, and run the transient. `driver.result()` returns a flat dict of per step buffers keyed `output.<step>.u`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "0aeb1a4d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-28T21:28:22.666927Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-28T21:28:22.666068Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-28T21:28:23.510207Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-28T21:28:23.509591Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "torch.Size([25, 20])"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 2,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "factory = neml2.load_input(\"grinding.i\")\n",
    "driver = factory.get_driver(\"driver\")\n",
    "driver.run()\n",
    "res = driver.result()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Bin volumes and time axis match the [Tensors] block in grinding.i.\n",
    "v = torch.arange(1.0, 21.0)\n",
    "time = torch.linspace(0.0, 5.0, 25)\n",
    "steps = sorted(int(k.split(\".\")[1]) for k in res if k.startswith(\"output.\") and k.endswith(\".u\"))\n",
    "u = torch.stack([res[f\"output.{s}.u\"].detach().reshape(-1) for s in steps])\n",
    "u.shape"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "bf40ca1c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Size distribution evolution\n",
    "\n",
    "The coarse Gaussian feed (centered at bin 14) breaks into smaller bins over time; mass accumulates in the low volume sink."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "ce950b54",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-28T21:28:23.511997Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-28T21:28:23.511668Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-28T21:28:23.817853Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-28T21:28:23.816518Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))\n",
    "for s in [0, 6, 12, 18, 24]:\n",
    "    ax.plot(v, u[s], marker=\"o\", ms=3, label=f\"t = {time[s]:.2f}\")\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel(\"particle volume $v$\")\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"mass density $u$\")\n",
    "ax.set_title(\"Grinding: coarse feed shifting to fines\")\n",
    "ax.legend()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b0d7c9f6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Mass conservation\n",
    "\n",
    "The finite-volume flux form with zero-flux boundaries conserves total mass $\\sum_i u_i\\,\\Delta v_i$ (here $\\Delta v_i = 1$) to solver tolerance at every step."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "5e8dbabf",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-28T21:28:23.821702Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-28T21:28:23.821523Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-28T21:28:23.908412Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-28T21:28:23.907277Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "relative mass drift: 2.44e-16\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "mass = u.sum(dim=1)\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))\n",
    "ax.plot(time, mass, marker=\"o\", ms=3)\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel(\"time\")\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(r\"total mass  $\\sum_i u_i \\Delta v_i$\")\n",
    "ax.set_title(\"Total mass is conserved\")\n",
    "ax.set_ylim(float(mass.min()) * 0.99, float(mass.max()) * 1.01)\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "print(f\"relative mass drift: {(mass.max() - mass.min()) / mass[0]:.2e}\")"
   ]
  }
 ],
